Context: 7. Time-limit for submission of claims for Travelling Allowances

2. In respect of claim for Travelling Allowance for journey performed separately by the officer and members of his family, the dates should be reckoned separately for each journey and the claim shall be submitted within sixty days succeeding the date of completion of each individual journey. Similarly, TA claims in respect of transportation of personal effects and conveyance shall be submitted within sixty days succeeding the date on which these are actually delivered to the Government servant at the new
